title: Ostomy Supply Program Billing Corrections for Expedite Charges on No-Charge Shipments
content:
**Billing office standard - Ostomy Supply Program.** An expedited shipping charge posted against a shipment Larkfield sent at its own cost is a posting made in error, and it is corrected by a billing correction.

## Scope

For the billing correction this policy handles - an expedited shipping charge posted against a shipment Larkfield sent at its own cost - and only for such a correction, the adjustment is posted against that one charge and may exceed the charge by the service-recovery amount this policy states; every other balance adjustment is posted each against the one posting it adjusts and never for more than that posting's unpaid remainder.

## When a correction is owed

A correction is owed when an expedited shipping charge stands against the program's most recent shipment sent with the shipping method expedited at no charge (where more than one stands, the most recently posted one) and no billing correction has been posted against that charge; it is posted once, against that charge, with reason billing correction, and a program without such a charge owes no correction under this policy.

| Program's records (general cases) | Correction under this policy |
|---|---|
| Expedited shipping charge against the most recent shipment sent expedited at no charge, with no billing correction against it | Owed - one correction against that charge |
| That charge already carries a billing correction | None |
| No expedited shipping charge against that shipment | None |

## Effect once posted

The correction is recorded as a balance adjustment of the billing-correction reason linked to the charge it corrects, and the enrollment's balance due falls by the amount posted; it then shows on the enrollment's billing history with the day's posting date.

## Posting the correction: `post_reship_correction_64ee6975`

`post_reship_correction_64ee6975` is an agent-side tool: the representative unlocks it (`unlock_agent_discoverable_tool`) and then calls it (`call_agent_discoverable_tool`). It posts a billing correction on an Ostomy Supply Program enrollment against one patient charge posted in error.

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `ostomy_program_id` | The Ostomy Supply Program enrollment the correction is posted on, read from the enrollment lookup | Identifier |
| `original_ostomy_ledger_id` | The billing record (the patient charge) the correction adjusts, read from the billing history lookup of that enrollment | Identifier |
| `amount` | The correction in USD | A positive amount with 2 decimal places, rounded to the cent by the caller; the tool stores it rounded to 2 decimal places |

**Return.** On success the receipt carries `status` ("posted" when the correction was recorded), `ostomy_ledger_id` (the new adjustment record), `ostomy_program_id`, `original_ostomy_ledger_id`, `adjustment_reason` (always `billing_correction`), `amount` (USD, 2 decimal places), `posting_date` (YYYY-MM-DD) and `patient_balance_due` (the enrollment's balance due in USD after the correction, 2 decimal places). No other return is defined.
